label: PF Backlog 551
title: C19: Security implementation agent (review from guidelines SSOT + IMPLEMENT controls per iteration) + S3 gate
body:
## Problem / why Today security is only an END-stage scan (`security` agent, Stage 5) and a release gate (`security-audit`). Security `security.agent.json` explicitly does NOT write code. So security controls are REVIEWED late or not IMPLEMENTED at all - rework is expensive and gaps ship. ## Goal & value Security becomes an IMPLEMENTER, per iteration, not a post-hoc reviewer. Each implementation iteration reviews against the guidelines SSOT + the product's derived security-profile and then WRITES the required controls (authz, input validation, secret handling, guardrail hooks, sandbox/egress hooks, audit hooks), re-verifies, and feeds the S3 gate. Independence is preserved by the S4 release gate (`security-audit`). ## In scope - New agent(s) under `agents/` with WRITE tools (`write_file`, `run_command`), parent link in `config/agent-hierarchy.json`, stage wiring in `pipeline-definition.json` (per-iteration, parallel to `code-review`), compliance checklist + regenerated cards. - Recommended split: `security-review` (detect, independent) -> `security-implement` (write controls) -> re-verify -> S3 gate; decision logic mirrors `code-review -> fix`. - Reads: `config/security-guidelines.json` (C18) + `products/

/security-profile.json` (C13) + the iteration diff. - Emits: implemented controls (code/config) + remaining gaps as security backlog/defect items (linked by item_id). - S3 gate consumes the verdict; S4 release gate stays `security-audit`. ## Out of scope - The guidelines SSOT (C18), the per-product profile (C13), the gate matrix itself (C14), the runtime control plane services (C5-C11). ## Acceptance criteria (G/W/T) - Given an iteration that lacks a control required by the profile, when the security agent runs, then it IMPLEMENTS the control (files changed) and re-verifies - not merely a report. - Given a critical gap it cannot implement, then it blocks the S3 gate and files a linked item. - Given the agent is added, then it is invoked on the runtime path (wired_audit 0 unwired). ## Data model (what is stored, where, owner) Agent spec `agents/*.agent.json`; findings/implemented controls surfaced as backlog/defect items (no new truth). ## Dependencies & links (by id) Depends on C18 (guidelines) + C13 (profile). Extends the review model (BI-PF-1066/1067) and C14 (BI-PF-1216). ## Verification / test plan Category test: agent invoked in the per-iteration lane; control implemented on a seeded gap; S3 gate blocks on a non-implementable critical; wired_audit clean.
